department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1 (fellowship nominations); final fall deadline March 1.
deadline.quote: Our priority deadline is December 1 for admission for the following fall semester.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required, but scores may help if your undergraduate institution is lesser known.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are currently not required for admission to our program.

also.quote: However if you earned your undergraduate degree at a lesser known institution, GRE scores could support your application

supervisor.value: You need not contact faculty before applying, but it is recommended.
supervisor.quote: PhD applicants are not required to contact faculty before applying, but it is recommended.

funding.value: Funding from faculty advisors is a significant factor in admission decisions.
funding.quote: Funding from faculty advisors is a significant factor in our admissions process.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; a bachelor's is enough.
entry_route.quote: No, a master's degree is not required to apply for the PhD program. Only a bachelor's degree is required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: ECE also admits for spring (October 1 deadline), but international students are urged to apply for fall.
